rubric_items.deep_module: pass — the plan adds no module and hides no behaviour behind a wrapper; it is a decision record naming two candidate fixes, so there is no interface exposed or widened.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — the plan proposes retiring/replacing the runtime allowance without naming its owner (imas_codex/graph/cypher_property_check.py) or the affected property sites, so a reader cannot extend the owner and will seek a fork.
rubric_items.interface_budget: a finding — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §2 proposes declaring an undeclared runtime property in LinkML (a new public schema definition) without naming what it retires or merges, or why nothing can be.
rubric_items.reuse_search: a finding — the plan cites no codebase mechanism, and its central premise ("all three currently sit in the permanent runtime-property allowance") misstates the contents of the one mechanism that owns that concept, imas_codex/graph/cypher_property_check.py.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — the plan proposes no wrapper over existing machinery; its two options are a schema declaration and a query/relationship migration, neither of which is a forwarding layer.
